title: [E13-02] Defined Payment, Fulfillment and Cost Metrics
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E13-02 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/14

**User Story:**
As a founder, I want to see payment, fulfillment and cost metrics, so I can evaluate viability.

**Epic:** E13 — Worker outcomes, producer share & impact reporting  
**Domain:** Analytics / Frontend / Backend  
**Type:** Feature  
**Priority:** P0  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Product/Analytics  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-029, US-040  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P0`, `release:B`, `epic:E13`, `analytics`, `frontend`, `backend`

**Dependencies:** [E06-04](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/119), [E10-01](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/142)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E06-04, E10-01.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Metric definitions documented and denominators available.
- [ ] Define each numerator, denominator, source events and period/timezone.
- [ ] Separate produced, approved, shipped, received and accepted fulfillment rates.
- [ ] Distinguish planned/simulated payments from verified settlement and outstanding obligations.
- [ ] Show denominator/coverage and avoid divide-by-zero or misleading zero defaults.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Build a shared metric registry/projection with scope controls; B may use disclosed fixtures for C settlement metrics.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Recalculate a known synthetic order manually, then test no-data and partial fulfillment cases.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
